summary: TMA Phase A backend + frontend testing complete. All 21 backend pytest tests passed (health, dev+HMAC auth, invalid hash 401, JWT invalid 401, onboarding flow, KYC upload/reject-txt, admin queue + approve grants access + reject with reason, admin users list, packages catalog, strategies regression, Tampermonkey script v8.75.0 with '5s_heikin_fractal' and 'falling back' markers). Frontend TMA (/tma/) renders full 4-step shell with all data-testids and t.me referral link (visible in input). Admin dashboard nav-tma-admin → dev sign-in works, tma-admin-page renders with filter buttons and 7-user list.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tma.py auth endpoint: dev bypass gated by TMA_DEV_MODE — good. Ensure TMA_DEV_MODE=false in production before Phase B ship.
KYC upload streams to local disk (/app/backend/uploads/tma_kyc). Consider S3/GCS in Phase B for container persistence and admin image access across replicas.
PO signup step is self-attestation only (documented mock). Consider affiliate postback verification before granting Elite access.
TmaAuthRequest referral_code is only accepted on first application — behavior is correct but not obvious; consider surfacing this in a comment for future contributors (already documented inline).
